rule.why: Both confirm the extra words with nothing in the reference.

blind.why: Both pick the engine's 'like that' in both orders.

rank.why: Y ties the three engines with nothing at the spot first, puts Whisper next for dropping 'maybe it was', and Parakeet last. X also puts Parakeet last, but ranks Whisper first and drops Qwen3 and Canary for 'extra punctuation/structure', which the rank should ignore.

misses.why: Both catch posh -> Porsche and cockney -> cogniz. X also notes B's dropped 'ah no I thought I was', but pads its list with backchannel 'yes' items scored 3, and lists 'MAYBE IT WAS' and 'THE FILM WAS' as missing when the engine has both.

overall.why: Y reads the extra filler correctly as harmless and unnoticeable, ranks sensibly and keeps a clean list; X over-reads the filler and fills its list with false or minor items.
